title: Arch deformation notebook
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. A full-frame generated engineering sketchbook plate: close oblique view down a snow corridor with a visibly buckled corrugated steel roof arch and snow pressing against its outer edge, a small worker inspecting the distorted form. Draw detailed steel ribs, timber side room and snow texture. One small inset contour sketch explains distorted versus original arch shape without numbers. Exact text only: ARCH DEFORMATION; Snow pressure; Original shape; Distorted arch. This is a source-informed conceptual illustration, not a facsimile of a numbered original figure, and must not claim a new measurement. No aircraft. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
